reusableAssets: LoginPage.fillLoginFormAndSubmit(user, pass) — admin-panel UI login in beforeEach (pages/LoginPage.js)
ApiHelper.loginAndGetToken(request) — get JWT for API-side test-data seeding (helpers/ApiHelper.js)

ApiHelper.createGeneralCashbackPerk(request, token, ids, value, type, minTx, title) — seed perks of a known category/type so filter, sort, delete and empty-state specs have deterministic data (helpers/ApiHelper.js)
ApiHelper.listPerks(request, token) — read back seeded perks and assert persisted order after Save order (helpers/ApiHelper.js)
ApiHelper.buildMerchantIds(count, offset) — bulk id generation when seeding merchant-cashback perks for the Type filter (helpers/ApiHelper.js)

PerksPage.clickAddPerk() + selectGeneralSpendCashbackType()/fillGeneralCashbackMandatory()/submitPerkExpectSuccess() — drive a full perk creation for the AC-05 redirect-to-filtered-table spec (pages/PerksPage.js)
BasePage — goToUrl/waitForVisible primitives every new table method builds on (pages/BasePage.js)
ConfigReader — base URL + admin credentials, no hardcoded values (helpers/ConfigReader.js)
newPageObjects: Extend the existing PerksPage.js (it already owns route #/perks) with a PERKS TABLE method group — do NOT create a parallel page object (coding-standards §Framework Architecture: extend, don't parallel-implement). New methods, with selectors captured from the live #/perks table before implementation: getTypeFilterOptions()/selectTypeFilter(type) and getCategoryFilterOptions()/selectCategoryFilter(category)/clearFilters() (AC-01); getTableColumnHeaders() to assert 'Type' and 'Category' columns and their per-row cell values (AC-02); isSortingAvailable()/getSortableColumns() to assert sorting hidden with no category and enabled once a category is applied (AC-03/AC-04); clickSortColumn(col) + readColumnOrder(col) to verify category-scoped sorting (AC-04); getRowActions(rowKey)/clickViewAction(rowKey) and clickDeleteAction(rowKey) with isDeleteEnabled(rowKey) reflecting perk status (AC-06/AC-07); confirmDeleteDialog()/cancelDeleteDialog() for the confirmation prompt (AC-08); getEmptyStateText() for no-results state (AC-10); reorderRow(fromIndex, toIndex) drag helper, isSaveOrderButtonVisible() and clickSaveOrder() capturing the batched PUT/PATCH order-save response (AC-11/AC-12). Follow PerksPage conventions: locators declared in constructor, Angular Material role/text + formcontrolname hooks, dated 'verified against live DOM' comment block, capture the network response for save/delete (like submitPerkAndCaptureCreate) rather than asserting URL only.

specs.name: perks_table_filters.spec.js
specs.description: AC-01: Type filter (Discount/Coupon, Merchant Cashback, Category Cashback, General Cashback) and Category filter render beside the existing status filter; each applies independently, in combination with each other, and combined with the status filter; table results narrow accordingly. Seeds mixed-type/category perks via ApiHelper first.

specs.name: perks_table_columns.spec.js
specs.description: AC-02: Table shows two new columns 'Type' and 'Category', and each seeded perk row displays its correct type and assigned category values.

specs.name: perks_table_sorting.spec.js
specs.description: AC-03/AC-04: With no category filter selected (all perks view) column sorting controls are hidden across the whole table; once a category filter is applied, sorting becomes available and sorting a column reorders perks within that category view only.

specs.name: perks_table_actions.spec.js
specs.description: AC-06/AC-07/AC-08: Actions column is the last column with View + Delete per row; View navigates to perk detail; Delete is clickable only for planned perks and dimmed/disabled for Active and Expired; clicking Delete on a planned perk opens a confirmation prompt, and cancelling aborts while confirming triggers deletion (assert the delete API response + row removal).

specs.name: perks_table_reorder.spec.js
specs.description: AC-11/AC-12 (+ Rasha/Farah comment): 'Save order' button is hidden until the admin changes the perk order and appears after any reorder; reverting to the original order hides it again; clicking Save order persists the new order in a single batched request (assert the captured save response and re-fetch via ApiHelper.listPerks to confirm the new order was saved).

specs.name: perks_table_empty_state.spec.js
specs.description: AC-10: Applying a filter combination (e.g. a Type/Category pairing with no matching perks) that returns no results shows the appropriate in-table empty state instead of an empty/blank grid.

specs.name: perk_create_redirect.spec.js
specs.description: AC-05: After successfully creating a new perk (reusing the existing PerksPage create flow), the admin is redirected to the perks table auto-filtered to the new perk's category with sorting enabled — assert the active Category filter matches the created perk and that sort controls are available.

notes: Web-only story: B10-56757 targets the Card Admin Portal perks table, which has NO mobile app surface — no iOS/Android BrowserStack app IDs are in scope, so NO Appium/Java test class is planned (per CLAUDE.md the Java framework at D:/projects applies to mobile/Selenium/API/config, none of which this table story exercises beyond the shared config it already reads). If a mobile perks-list view later appears, the equivalent plan would add a PerksListPage under D:/projects/src/main/java/modals/cardsAdminPanel/ + a TestNG class under src/test/java, reusing AdminAuthorizationApiClient and CardAdminPanelPerksApiClient. Reuse-before-build enforced: no existing page object covers the perks LIST/table (current PerksPage.js is the create form on #/perks/create), so the new work is added as a method group ON PerksPage.js (same #/perks route) rather than a new file, per coding-standards. All new specs live in D:\breadfast-qa\B10-56757\automation\tests\; PerksPage.js extensions are edited in the shared D:\breadfast-qa\automation\pages\ copy and mirrored to the runnable D:\Playwright\b55168_pom copy. Selectors for every new table method must be captured from the live #/perks DOM before implementation (no live table selectors exist yet — same open-dependency pattern as the create-form fields). Each spec title mirrors its BrowserStack case verbatim and a BrowserStack-case→spec mapping table goes in the story automation README (1:1 traceability). Prefer network-response capture (delete + save-order calls) over URL-only assertions, matching submitPerkAndCaptureCreate.
